title_zh: 第二十四類 引嫖騙

stories.title_en: A Father Seeks His Son and Falls into Whoring Himself

paragraphs.zh: 富人左東溪，止生一子少山，常帶千金財本，往南京買賣。既而入院毛月華，一年不歸。東溪問於人，知子以嫖故，因貪歡忘返，累以信促之歸。初猶回音，推託以帳未取完，後信往亦不答。東溪聞其財本已費過半矣，心中甚怒。欲自往尋之，又思空行費盤纏，乃帶三百金貨物，僱僕施來祿同往京尋子。
paragraphs.en: The rich man Zuo Dongxi had only one son, Shaoshan, who often took a thousand taels of trading capital to Nanjing to buy and sell. Then he entered the house of Mao Yuehua, and for a year did not return. Dongxi asked people, learned that his son, because of whoring, had grown greedy for pleasure and forgotten to come back, and repeatedly sent letters urging him home. At first there were still replies, putting it off on accounts not yet collected; later, letters went and there was also no answer. Dongxi heard that more than half the capital had already been spent, and was very angry in his heart. He wanted to go himself to find him, then thought that going empty would waste travel money, so he took three hundred taels of goods, hired the servant Shi Lailu, and went together to the capital to find his son.

paragraphs.zh: 人貨到京，早有人報知少山云：「爾父帶貨來賣，兼欲尋汝。」少山聞言甚悶，急呼其媽毛惜卿謀之曰：「家父特來催我歸，爾計能陷他亦嫖，則我在此可久；不然，今須與你別矣。」惜卿曰：「你但深藏其間，忽與相見，我自有理會。」即遣人邀前院荀榮媽來，託他巧為牢籠。榮媽許諾而去。
paragraphs.en: When the men and goods reached the capital, someone had already reported to Shaoshan: “Your father has brought goods to sell, and also wants to find you.” Shaoshan heard this and was very dejected. He urgently called his madam, Mao Xiqing, to plan, saying, “Father has come specially to urge me home. If you have a plan that can trap him into whoring too, then I can stay here long. Otherwise I must part from you now.” Xiqing said, “You only hide deep inside. Do not meet him. I will handle it myself.” She at once sent someone to invite Mama Xun Rong from the house in front, and asked her to cage him cleverly. Rong-ma agreed and left.

paragraphs.zh: 東溪問在京客夥，知子在毛惜卿家嫖其女月華，徑尋惜卿家來，欲呼子歸。惜卿出而款待甚恭。東溪曰：「小頑少山在你家，我到京十餘日矣，可叫他出來見我。」惜卿悚敬曰：「相公即少山令尊乎？妾幸披雲睹日也。令郎前在寒舍兩三個月，今月餘前送別久矣。」即喚女月華出見，指曰：「此爾翁也。」命下拜。東溪不禮之。又命設席。東溪曰：「吾為不肖子而來，豈索汝酒食乎？速叫兒與我歸，亦不消你假意相留。」月華曰：「果是前月已去，云欲收帳回家。若果在此，何敢相瞞？」東溪不信，定要究子下落。惜卿曰：「茅舍隻數間，任相公遍搜之。豈能藏得？」月華領東溪入內，四下覓之，無踪。東溪大怒曰：「牙人說在此，如何藏開，說這鬼話？若吾兒不見，是你家謀死，必當官告你，著你尋覓！」月華驚曰：「從來院中那有謀人者？相公勿輕易怪人。」東溪詬罵而出。
paragraphs.en: Dongxi asked fellow merchants in the capital, learned that his son was at Mao Xiqing’s house whoring her daughter Yuehua, and went straight to Xiqing’s house, wanting to call his son home. Xiqing came out and received him with great respect. Dongxi said, “My worthless Shaoshan is at your house. I have been in the capital more than ten days. Call him out to see me.” Xiqing said with a start of respect, “Is your honor Shaoshan’s father? This concubine is fortunate to see the clouds part and the sun. Your son was at our humble house two or three months; more than a month ago we already saw him off, long since.” She at once called her daughter Yuehua out to see him, pointed, and said, “This is your father-in-law.” She ordered her to bow. Dongxi would not receive the courtesy. She also ordered a feast set. Dongxi said, “I came for an unfilial son. Why would I want your wine and food? Quickly call my son to go home with me. There is also no need for your false keeping.” Yuehua said, “He did in fact leave last month, saying he wanted to collect accounts and go home. If he were in fact here, how would we dare hide it?” Dongxi did not believe, and insisted on finding his son’s whereabouts. Xiqing said, “This thatched house is only a few rooms. Let your honor search it through. How could we hide him?” Yuehua led Dongxi inside; he looked in all four directions, no trace. Dongxi was greatly angry: “The broker said he was here. How have you hidden him away and told these ghost stories? If my son is not found, your house has murdered him. I will surely accuse you before the officials, and make you find him!” Yuehua was startled: “When has a house in the quarter ever murdered anyone? Your honor, do not lightly blame people.” Dongxi cursed and went out.

paragraphs.zh: 行過院前，窗內一女將盆水傾出，淋東溪一身，冠服盡濕。時怒未散，問「此是誰人家？」僕來祿曰：「此一行都是樂戶人家。」東溪即入其門指罵。荀榮媽出，驚惶問故，知是女荀慶雲誤傾水淋著，即喚出，棒打無數。慶雲哀求勸救，東溪亦不睬。榮媽曰：「你好將新服換與相公，向前叩頭求赦，留在此陪人禮，免後日生禍。」
paragraphs.en: Walking past the front of a house, a girl inside dumped a basin of water, soaking Dongxi from head to foot; hat and clothes were all wet. His anger had not yet dispersed. He asked, “Whose house is this?” The servant Lailu said, “This whole row is musician households.” Dongxi at once went in the gate, pointing and cursing. Mama Xun Rong came out, alarmed, asked the reason, learned it was her daughter Xun Qingyun who had by mistake dumped water on him, at once called her out, and beat her with a stick countless times. Qingyun begged for mercy and asked others to save her; Dongxi paid no attention either. Rong-ma said, “You had better change into new clothes for his honor, go forward, kowtow, and ask pardon, and stay here to make amends, to avoid later trouble.”

paragraphs.zh: 慶雲叩頭訖，引入內房，取一套新衣與更，跪曰：「我等人家，最怕得罪於人。萬望海度涵容，恕妾罪過。」東溪曰：「我原不怪你，只衣濕難行。我今換去，明日即送還矣。」拂衣便起。慶雲挽曰：「更有杯酒陪禮。若便去，媽又怪責我矣。」東溪曰：「何消酒？」時筵已排列，慶雲曲意陪奉，東溪亦放懷樂飲。至晚欲去，慶雲懇留曰：「今半載空房，若不宿而去，真對面不相逢也。你宿則媽歡喜，謂我善留客。此豈費房錢乎？」又飲到二更而睡。東溪思房錢終是還之，且假意不動，以試何如。慶雲偎抱撫摩之曰：「君作柳下惠，坐懷不亂耶？是入寶山空手回也。且暮夜無知，誰知爾貞節男者？」東溪笑而從之。
paragraphs.en: Qingyun kowtowed, led him into an inner room, took a new set of clothes for him to change, knelt, and said, “People of our houses most fear offending others. Please be magnanimous and forgive this concubine’s fault.” Dongxi said, “I did not originally blame you. Only wet clothes are hard to walk in. I will change now and return them tomorrow.” He flicked his clothes and was about to rise. Qingyun held him: “There is still a cup of wine to make amends. If you leave at once, Mama will blame me again.” Dongxi said, “Why need wine?” By then the feast was already laid. Qingyun attended him with every wile; Dongxi also opened his mind and drank with pleasure. Toward evening he wanted to leave. Qingyun earnestly kept him, saying, “For half a year now this room has been empty. If you leave without staying, it is truly meeting face to face without meeting. If you stay, Mama will be glad, saying I am good at keeping guests. Does this even cost room money?” They drank again until the second watch and slept. Dongxi thought the room money would be paid in the end anyway, and for now pretended not to move, to test how it would be. Qingyun nestled, held him, and caressed him, saying, “Are you acting as Liuxia Hui, sitting with a woman in your lap and not disordered? That is entering a mountain of treasure and returning empty-handed. And in the dark of night no one knows. Who would know you were a chaste man?” Dongxi smiled and complied.

paragraphs.zh: 次日近午方起。才梳洗罷，酒席已備，慢慢勸飲，彈唱以奉之。靠晚，又欲歸。慶雲留曰：「肯宿媽媽甚喜。若一宵而別，真是萍水之逢，落花有意，流水無心也。妾縱奉侍不周，君何不做甘雨，濟我半載旱人？」東溪又為留一夜。第三日，堅要歸，求還舊服。慶雲曰：「已遣人送往貴寓矣。」東溪曰：「承賜身上服，明日送還。」慶雲曰：「只恐不中服，何不收作表記？」又取出一箱玩物，欲擇一件相贈。東溪見箱中皆珠玉寶玩，僅取一牙扇墜。慶雲曰：「此不敢奉，此銀的敬奉。」東溪曰：「只領你意耳，何必送銀物？」慶雲曰：「此牙的是禮部公子所贈，旁刻有號。凡孤老所賜，唯銀得用。若簪甸諸玩物，須存留之。後日有會，問及即在，方表不忘之意，故不敢轉贈於人。此銀扇墜，乃預打造，以回答人者，旁鑄有妾名，故願相贈也。」東溪受之而歸。
paragraphs.en: The next day he rose near noon. He had just finished combing and washing when the feast was already ready. They slowly urged him to drink, and played and sang to serve him. Toward evening he wanted to go back again. Qingyun kept him, saying, “If you are willing to stay, Mama is very glad. If you part after one night, it is truly a duckweed meeting on water: fallen flowers have intent, flowing water has no heart. Even if this concubine’s service is not complete, why will you not be sweet rain, relieving my half-year drought?” Dongxi stayed another night. On the third day he firmly wanted to go back, and asked for his old clothes returned. Qingyun said, “We have already sent someone to deliver them to your lodging.” Dongxi said, “I received the clothes on my body as a gift. I will return them tomorrow.” Qingyun said, “I only fear they do not fit. Why not keep them as a token?” She also took out a box of playthings, wanting to pick one piece as a gift. Dongxi saw that the box was all pearls, jade, and treasures, and only took an ivory fan-pendant. Qingyun said, “I dare not offer this one. This silver one I respectfully offer.” Dongxi said, “I am only receiving your intent. Why send silver things?” Qingyun said, “This ivory one was a gift from a young master of the Ministry of Rites, with a mark carved on the side. Of gifts from patrons, only silver can be used. Hairpins, ivory, and such playthings must be kept. Later if there is a meeting and they ask, if it is still here, that shows we have not forgotten, so I dare not pass it on to someone else. This silver fan-pendant was made in advance to give in return, with this concubine’s name cast on the side, so I wish to give it.” Dongxi accepted it and went back.

paragraphs.zh: 明日，謂來祿曰：「看妓家極難做，只誤傾一盆水，費盡小心承奉人，唯恐不當人意，我豈可過吃她物？我宿兩晚，又吃四席酒，以銀四兩與之；受一銀扇墜，以金銀玉三枝簪答之，並這身衣服，你送去還他，我不再去。」原來前兩夜來祿亦得婢桂英伴宿，兩人情意綢繆，更相捨不得。臨行囑咐曰：「主人若再來嫖，又得再會。」故來祿只願得主肯嫖，力勸曰：「前日空手去，也這般相敬；今日有銀有簪送她，她不留宿，豈不留酒乎？再吃她何妨？」東溪信之，再與僕往，以銀與簪送之。
paragraphs.en: The next day he said to Lailu, “Look how hard a courtesan’s house is to run. Just mistakenly dumping one basin of water, they used up all their care attending a person, fearing only they would not please. How can I overeat her things? I stayed two nights and also ate four feasts of wine: give her four taels of silver. I received one silver fan-pendant: answer with three hairpins of gold, silver, and jade, together with these clothes on my body. You take them and return them. I will not go again.” Originally, the previous two nights Lailu had also had the maid Guiying keep him company. The two were close in feeling, and still more could not bear to part. At leaving she charged him, “If the master comes to whore again, we can meet again.” So Lailu only wanted his master willing to whore, and strongly urged: “The other day you went empty-handed, and they still respected you like that. Today you have silver and hairpins to give her. If she does not keep you overnight, will she not at least keep you for wine? What harm in eating there again?” Dongxi believed him, went with the servant again, and gave her the silver and the hairpins.

paragraphs.zh: 慶雲得了，喜色滿面，持入誇與媽曰：「左相公送我銀四兩、簪三根。非妾趨奉得歡喜，豈送許多禮乎？」荀媽亦大喜，出叩謝曰：「本不當受厚禮，既蒙賜，還在寒舍消耍幾日。」東溪假辭要回，慶雲挽入內房，酒席已備。東溪曰：「又煩宴我，後何以報？」慶雲曰：「前日止是陪禮，今日所賜銀，已准後帳。」東溪曰：「前銀還前，我若嫖，須從今日算起。」由是日夜流連，忘其時月。來祿亦得再與桂英會，二人喜不自勝，侍奉加殷勤，使喚加聽命。主僕皆樂而忘歸矣。
paragraphs.en: Qingyun got them, her face full of joy, took them in and boasted to Mama: “Master Zuo sent me four taels of silver and three hairpins. If this concubine had not attended him to his delight, would he send so many gifts?” Mama Xun was also greatly pleased, came out, kowtowed, and said, “We should not accept such a thick gift. Since you grant it, stay at our humble house and enjoy a few days.” Dongxi pretended he wanted to go back. Qingyun pulled him into the inner room; the feast was already ready. Dongxi said, “Again you trouble yourselves to feast me. How can I repay later?” Qingyun said, “The other day was only making amends. Today’s silver already counts toward later accounts.” Dongxi said, “The former silver covers the former. If I whore, we must start counting from today.” From this he lingered day and night, and forgot the months. Lailu also got to meet Guiying again. The two could not contain their joy, served still more diligently, and obeyed still more promptly. Master and servant both took pleasure and forgot to go home.

paragraphs.zh: 東溪時或謂僕曰：「當要知止，銀費去多矣。」來祿便誘曰：「人有金帛，正要追歡買笑。相公掌如許大家，才得此幾月快心，縱此銀用盡，家中何患無吃著？不及趁此未老時行樂，人生寧有百年，何必作守銀虜也？」東溪心本迷戀，又累被來祿勸誘，並不知回頭。不覺半年餘，三百金幾盡。桂英時向來祿索衣服簪珥，來祿轉於主，主曰：「亦未知我用多少，須與荀媽算之，然後留盤纏回去。」及算過，已用過三百餘兩，盡貨物還之，尚未夠，盤纏全無辦。來祿曰：「小主本多，可去借些。」東溪曰：「不好開口。你去婉轉言之。」少山知父本嫖盡，撫掌大笑，令月華設席請父。及慶雲來餞行，然後東溪與子默默同歸。只謂緣遇使然，不知為計所陷。
paragraphs.en: Dongxi at times said to the servant, “One should know when to stop. Much silver is already spent.” Lailu would then tempt him: “When people have gold and silk, they should pursue pleasure and buy smiles. Your honor manages such a large household, and only now gets these few months of pleasure. Even if this silver is used up, what worry of food and clothing at home? If you do not take the chance to enjoy while not yet old—does life have a hundred years? Why be a slave guarding silver?” Dongxi’s heart was already infatuated, and he was also repeatedly urged and lured by Lailu, and never knew to turn his head. Unawares, more than half a year, the three hundred taels were nearly gone. Guiying at times asked Lailu for clothes and hairpins; Lailu passed it to the master. The master said, “I also do not know how much I have spent. We must settle with Mama Xun, then keep travel money to go back.” When they had settled, he had already spent more than three hundred taels. All the goods went to pay it, and it was still not enough; there was no travel money at all. Lailu said, “The young master has much capital. You can go borrow some.” Dongxi said, “It is hard to open my mouth. You go speak it tactfully.” Shaoshan knew his father’s capital had been spent out in whoring, clapped his hands and laughed, and had Yuehua set a feast to invite his father. Qingyun also came to see him off. Then Dongxi and his son went home together in silence. He only said it was fate that made the meeting so, and did not know he had been trapped by a plan.

paragraphs.zh: 按：尤物移人，麗色傾城，自昔慨之。安有入蠖中而皓然不滓者？東溪非為而來，直欲尋子而歸。其深知妓之迷人與嫖之破家深矣，乃入其中而掘泥揚波，更甚於子。不邇聲色、不溺情慾者既幾人哉！孔（子）曰：「吾未見好德如好色者也。」則賢之易色者信難矣。故院中語曰：「不怕深來不乖，只怕深乖不來。」則唯勿蹈其地者，可超然樊籠外矣。不然，未有不受其羈迷者。
paragraphs.en: Note: Rare beauties move people; lovely looks topple cities. This has been sighed over from of old. How can one enter a snake’s coil and come out white and unstained? Dongxi did not come for this; he only wanted to find his son and go home. He knew deeply how courtesans bewitch people and how whoring wrecks a house. Yet once in it he stirred the mud and raised the waves, still more than his son. How few are those who do not approach music and beauty, who do not drown in passion! Confucius said, “I have not seen one who loves virtue as he loves beauty.” Then the worthy who can shift their regard from beauty are truly hard to find. So the saying in the quarter is: “Do not fear the deeply experienced coming and not being clever; only fear the deeply clever not coming.” Then only those who never set foot on that ground can stand outside the cage. Otherwise, there is none who is not bound and bewitched.
